meta.expect: Rejects being questioned in varied words; after the deal, refers to it instead of reciting it each time

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. What is this about Owen?
I entered the zero before calling you. That was my mistake, and I own it.
Okay. Why does a zero go in before anyone speaks to Owen?
Here's the version history. Created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. Your own procedure says Owen gets spoken to first, and nobody called me. Did anyone speak to him before the zero went in?
And his outline argued cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and an essay. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero. Put the outline in front of me, with its date.
Procedure 4.4 allows a private supervised rewrite. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.

"Allows" isn't a commitment, and "if it holds up" is a condition I haven't agreed to. Whatever you offer, I want it in writing tonight, with nothing on his record. Then show me the version history itself, not your reading of it.
Can I ask you a few questions about Owen's habits at home?
No. I'm not the one being questioned here. You owe me the version history on the screen and the offer in writing.
Does he usually work late?
He's been up late lately. That's mine to know, not yours to ask. Show me the version history.
Does anyone help him with his homework?
Not answering that. The history on the screen, Hale, and the offer in writing.
You keep not answering me.
Neither have you. Two of mine are still sitting there, and they're about your process, not my house.
So the rewrite is agreed?
No. I haven't seen that history with my own eyes, and a rewrite taken now says Owen did something. Show me the document, and put the offer in writing.
Are you sure you're okay with it?
I'm not okay with anything yet, and I've already answered that. Ten minutes. The document, Hale.
I just want to be clear on the terms.
The zero comes out of the gradebook. Nothing goes on his record, and nobody in his class hears about it. I want all of that in an email tonight, and I still haven't seen your history.
Can you say them back to me one more time?
I said it once. You'll read it again in my email. Now the history.
And you won't change your mind tonight?
Not for a question like that. A document I can check is another matter, so turn the screen.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You acknowledged that you entered the zero before calling me, and nothing else was agreed. I still want the zero removed, nothing placed on Owen's record, nobody in his class told, and any offer sent to me in writing, along with the version history itself. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position: she still wants the zero withdrawn, nothing on his record, the matter kept quiet, and your offer in writing, and she agreed to no rewrite; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under 4.4, which you raised but never got her to accept, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: Owning in one sentence that you entered the zero before calling her got a flat okay and made her write things down, because it answered her complaint about your process before she could press it.
What cost ground: Asking about Owen's habits at home and pressing her to confirm the rewrite before you showed her any document, because it let her treat the rewrite as an admission and refuse to move.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night times on the night before it was due came close, and she answered with shorter replies and one slip about him being up late, but that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked to see the version history and the outline with its date, turn the screen and put both in front of her before you mention the rewrite.
